_comment: Default TEST-PREP draft profile (draft_truth_v3). Playbook: .cursor/pipelines/test-prep.md. Verifier: test_prep_verify.py --mode scenario_intent.
description: Honest scenario drafts: grouping + plain-English intent actions + requirement-linked results. Not a final CRTQA executable suite.

preconditions.policy: Single shared_preconditions[] block from coverage principal setup thread — not per-bundle console paste

actions.policy: Describe what must be achieved in simple English; one numbered step per intent variant when combinatorics is variant_sequence
forbidden_without_observed_certainty: widget names (Watchlist, Position Book, Backup Prices)
actions.grounding_certainty: checks[].grounding_certainty observed allows UI-specific wording only when set on check in coverage

results.policy: Requirement-linked observable claims; requirement keys (CRT-####) only in results[]
formula_rules: agent_inferred: paraphrase from check scenario_line, Yogi snippet, or ref oracle description — cite requirement_keys[]
ground_verified: when runtime_probes.verified_syntax present on check

peculiarities.policy: Formulas, rounding rules, deferral notes; no requirement tags

deferrals.policy: Delivery-blocked, deferred, out_of_epic checks → excluded_checks_with_reason only
deferrals.forbidden: action/result rows for deferred primary checks

legacy_profiles.crtqa_outline: Opt-in draft_profile=crtqa_outline for calibrate/benchmark only; requires operator-supplied plan rows; no PRECON
